newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends lower in kerb, seen down.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends lower in kerb, seen down.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.03 rupees down at 41.13 to the dollar on higher dollar demand in the kerb market on Wednesday and dealers said it might dip tomorrow.
"Dollar demand remained higher than supply," a dealer said. "The rupee will weaken further against the dollar as the U.S. currency has firmed abroad against most other currencies."

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates rose to 2.80 percent from 2.70 at the open. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
